subject: Libraries not loading in Shiny app on server

messages.author: 9e0792f0b44e398c
messages.subject: Libraries not loading in Shiny app on server
parts:
Hi all,

I recently uploaded my ShinyApp to the Shiny server. No errors were reported during the deployment of the application, and the process completed successfully.

However, when I ran my application, I noticed that functions do not run and instead print the message that, for example, "could not find function getURL". Additionally, I had specified the tabSetPanels to update themselves based on different user choices, but they too have no effect.

Here is the link to my application: https://aliakazmi.shinyapps.io/QualitativeAnalysisApp-R/
Here is the link to my code: https://github.com/noobuseR/QualitativeAnalysisApp-R

Thanks in advance for any advise/assistance.

Kind Regards.
AA

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Libraries not loading in Shiny app on server
parts:
Hi,

I noticed your code doesn't seem to have a call to: library(RCurl), which is why your code is unable to find the getURL() function. You will need to ensure that your server.R and ui.R files have the correct library() calls for packages you are using in your app.

-Andy

The issue here might be that the shinyapps package attempts to detect your application dependencies by searching for explicit library() or require() calls, which your code may not match. You can confirm if your application's dependencies are being detected by running:

shinyapps::appDependencies()

Can you paste the output of that command here?

-Andy

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Libraries not loading in Shiny app on server
parts:
Yes. It seems that your dependencies are not being detected by shinyapps because of the syntax you're using to load the packages. Unfortunately, its quite complicated to write a parser that is capable of understanding that syntax. The solution here is to change your calls to:

library(shiny)
library(fastcluster)
etc...

And then re-run deployApp(). 

Let me know the result.

-Andy

On Thursday, February 20, 2014 8:16:40 PM UTC+4, Andy Kipp wrote:
Yes. It seems that your dependencies are not being detected by shinyapps because of the syntax you're using to load the packages. Unfortunately, its quite complicated to write a parser that is capable of understanding that syntax. The solution here is to change your calls to:

library(shiny)
library(fastcluster)
etc...

And then re-run deployApp(). 

Let me know the result.

-Andy

On Thursday, February 20, 2014 8:02:25 PM UTC+4, Andy Kipp wrote:
The issue here might be that the shinyapps package attempts to detect your application dependencies by searching for explicit library() or require() calls, which your code may not match. You can confirm if your application's dependencies are being detected by running:

shinyapps::appDependencies()

Can you paste the output of that command here?

-Andy

Thanks ever so much for the reply.

I have the following code, which loads the RCurl and other libraries:

sapply(libraries, function(x) require(x,character.only=TRUE))

I am pretty sure the above command should load the necessary packages and so the ShinyApp must work, no?


On Thursday, February 20, 2014 7:06:59 PM UTC+4, Andy Kipp wrote:
Hi,

I noticed your code doesn't seem to have a call to: library(RCurl), which is why your code is unable to find the getURL() function. You will need to ensure that your server.R and ui.R files have the correct library() calls for packages you are using in your app.

-Andy
